name: Haas lathe
description: Millimetre Haas lathe dialect. Percent-delimited program O00001 with sequence numbers. Diameter mode is the default. The safety block is G21 G18 G40 G80. Feed per minute is G98. G99 is written only around G32 thread passes (Haas requires feed per revolution) and G98 is restored before the next feed. Constant surface speed is G50 S max-rpm, then G96 S metres per minute. Direct rpm is G97. The spindle is M3, M4 or M5. Tool word T0101. Arcs are I and K, I a radius. Threading is G32, lead on F. Home is G53 G0 X0 then G53 G0 Z0. The program ends with M30 and %. C axis: M154, G28 H0.; brake M14/M15; live tools P{rpm} M133/M134, stop M135; G112/G113 and G107. Sub-spindle is G55 G14; G15 G54 returns to the main. These codes and part transfer are cited in `references`. Tailstock: M21 advance, M22 retract; not positioned with B words. Parts catcher: M36 before the part-off plunge, M37 after the retract. Bar feed: G53 home, then G105 alone on its line (no comment; J and K override #3100 and #3102 for that line only).
references: M154/M155 C axis engage/disengage, G28 H0. unwinds C: https://www.haascnc.com/service/service-content/guide-procedures/lathe---m-codes.html and Haas NGC Lathe Operator's Manual (96-8910) G82/G83 live examples
M14/M15 main spindle brake: Haas NGC Lathe Operator's Manual M-code list
C axis, H incremental C, Setting 102 C feed: https://www.haascnc.com/service/online-operator-s-manuals/lathe-operator-s-manual/lathe---options-programming.html
G112/G113 XY to XC interpolation, G17, X radius, G98 required, no centre crossing: https://www.haascnc.com/service/online-operator-s-manuals/lathe-operator-s-manual/lathe---options-programming.html
G107 Y0 C0 R/Q cylindrical mapping in G19, bare G107 cancels: https://www.haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=lathe.value=G107.html

Y axis, G17/G19 live milling planes, no activation code: Haas NGC Lathe Operator's Manual 6.12 / https://www.haascnc.com/service/online-operator-s-manuals/lathe-operator-s-manual/lathe---options-programming.html
G14/G15: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §7.1.8 (G14 secondary spindle swap; G14 mirrors Z automatically; cancelled by G15/M30/reset)
G55: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §7.1.72 example: G55 for secondary spindle work offset
G199/G198: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §7.1.71-72 (G199 synchronous spindle control, optional R phase degrees; G198 cancel; transfer example)
M110/M111: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §8.1.35 (secondary chuck clamp/unclamp; spring part ejector acts when the jaws open)
M10/M11: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §8.1.6 (main chuck clamp/unclamp)
M143/M144/M145: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §8.1.44 (secondary spindle forward/reverse/stop, speed on P)
B axis: Haas NGC lathe manual 96-8910 §6.34 (DS lathes: the secondary spindle housing moves on the B axis)
